model_scenario.basis: credit-scenario on incumbent_anatomy anchor (D=18262.37 at s=0.2778 CLAIM; marginal bar 0.0556); c ranges bracket second-tier refill dots vs weakest retained-class dots. No ranking-unit sum is divided by D (IR-DEC-11).

mechanism_card.hypothesis: Same mechanism, stronger per-dot contrast: refills only into the top-quartile prior blocks. If the km prior is real, this arm should match or beat conc-t50 per receipt despite moving 36% fewer dots; if capacity-driven second-tier placements dominate, it will not.
mechanism_card.mechanism: Top-quartile blocks are the most packing-saturated (greedy capacity 2,496 dots measured), so dose is capacity-limited to 2,400; the arm therefore also prices saturation: refills must use residual ridge gaps between retained dots.
mechanism_card.non_fault_mimic: Saturated blocks are saturated because ridge detectors fire densely on non-fault lineament swarms (joint sets, flow banding, yardang/dune lineations).
mechanism_card.predicted_sign_and_size: Bracketing: -0.002 to +0.009 DTI (MODEL). Pre-registered >= spread-m2400; unordered vs t50 (contrast vs dose).
mechanism_card.falsifier: Live < conc-t50 receipt by >=0.002 with conc-t50 > R0: concentration helps only before saturation; top-quartile infill is kernel-redundant with retained dots.
